name: Rounded Resolution-Slope Defect
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C$, define $\nu_k(C)=\lceil\lambda_k(C)\rceil-1$, where $\lambda_k$ is the resolution slope of the literal ideal $J_C$ over the field $k$.
normalization: The value is zero exactly when $J_C$ has a linear resolution; it is distinct from the Yang depth defect.
